Collapsed Content

Collapsed <details> blocks printed EMPTY, so the POC replaced them with plain visible content. Nothing in a document may depend on a disclosure triangle to become visible on paper.

This paragraph stands in for the content that used to be inside a collapsed block, and it must be present in the output HTML and in the PDF.

Literal text that looks like html but is escaped: <details> and <summary> and <div hidden> should all appear as visible characters, not as markup.
